name: stockbit-mcp
description: IDX market data, bandarmology and your Stockbit account inside Claude Desktop. Unofficial.
long_description: Market data, analysis, chart drawing, read-only brokerage portfolios, local paper simulation and Stockbit website virtual trading. Real-money execution is removed. Sign in through your own browser. Brokerage portfolio access additionally needs a securities session, unlocked through the local terminal; no tool accepts a PIN.
